recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source edit is needed unless a future work-group decision changes history parameter repeatability or _at semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-13175 asked what 'single' meant in the _history parameter table; the Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution said to remove 'single', document that the parameters can only be used once, and clarify that the 'more than one' comment refers to resource versions.
initial_application: The change was applied by 43de3831ef5165991d96e0a259157b399fdb6a6f (svn revision 14166), which removed the 'single' cells, clarified _at as possibly returning more than one version of a given resource, and added the one-use rule. Later typo and table-cleanup commits retained that rule.
additional_context: FHIR-17265 later moved the more-than-one-version clarification into the surrounding notes and pointed _at to search.html#date; FHIR-35781 later split the history parameter table into name/type/description columns and added no-prefix/no-modifier text. Both related issues are already represented on the combined branch. The 2017 Zulip thread and 2018-07-09 FHIR-I minutes support the same interpretation and show no conflicting direction.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because source/http.html already matches the seed resolution and source/documentation.html confirms the HTTP page is a current specification page.
